headline: Indonesian Futsal Federation Sets Extraordinary Congress For December
seoTitle: Federasi Futsal Indonesia Sets Extraordinary Congress
metaDescription: The Indonesian Futsal Federation plans an extraordinary congress on December 11, 2026, amid ongoing disputes involving PSSI officials and ethics complaints.
aiSummaryBullets: The Indonesian Futsal Federation (FFI) has scheduled an extraordinary congress for December 11, 2026.
Provincial futsal associations have expressed support for the FFI in its decision to bring ethics complaints to the PSSI committee.
PSSI leadership stated that the FFI is dependent on the association and confirmed the federation is open to leadership candidates.
aiContextParagraph: The Indonesian Futsal Federation (FFI) has officially scheduled an extraordinary congress for December 11, 2026, and submitted the plans to the Football Association of Indonesia (PSSI). This development follows rising tensions between the organizations. The FFI has lodged complaints with the PSSI Ethics Committee against PSSI officials, including Erick Thohir and Yunus Nusi, citing concerns regarding administrative conduct. In response, Yunus Nusi expressed surprise at the reports and stated that the PSSI has reasons to file a counter-complaint against former FFI Chairman Michael Sianipar. Provincial futsal associations from regions such as Papua and Aceh have voiced support for the FFI's current actions, while PSSI officials maintain that the federation operates under their purview and have indicated that all qualified individuals, including former leadership, may participate in future elections.
whyItIsViral: The story is trending due to high-velocity coverage across four national news outlets reporting on the ongoing administrative conflict within the national sports federation.
